description: This Java class 'SensorGauge' provides UI components for displaying sensor data as gauges, including creating gauges, handling user interactions like double-click and right-click, and managing gauge categories and updates.

classes.name: SensorGauge
classes.description: UI component class for sensor gauges, handling creation, interaction, and updates of gauge displays.

classes.name: SensorGauge.GaugeChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to gauge change events triggered by user interactions.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge component for a given sensor with specified listener and extra menu item.

methods.name: createGaugeBody
methods.description: Builds the gauge display and sets up sensor update listeners and mouse interactions.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays a context menu for gauge options on right-click.

methods.name: fillGaugeMenuItems
methods.description: Populates the context menu with sensor categories and sensors for selection.

methods.name: handleDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click event to detach the sensor gauge into a separate window.

methods.name: createRadial
methods.description: Constructs and configures a Radial gauge object with specified parameters.
